column2: The team is growing. Hire new staff in the “Team” tab. Meanwhile someone in the dark is eyeing your register.
Late evening. Everyone has gone home and Capy sits over the takings. Rain outside, and something stirs by the back door.
Is someone sobbing? Shnyr, is that you?
Not me. It's the rain. On my face. Only on my face.
Shnyr, why do you do it? Don't you have a home?
There's a crate behind the bakery. No friends. At all. Not even someone to sit quietly next to.
I'd like someone to just say “hi”. Everyone yells “catch the raccoon”.
Hi, Shnyr. Just because. Come in, we have tea and buns.
Seriously? Then I'm done stealing. Well... almost. Kidding. Probably. Thanks.
Since then Shnyr isn't a thief but one of us. He still glances at the till sometimes, but now with embarrassment. Big things were ahead for everyone.
Months passed. Shnyr became a customer favourite, and the team became a family that argues over coffee. The shop grew into a store, then a supermarket, and now...
On the street stands a mall with a glass roof, a cinema and the smell of fresh pastries. Competitors quietly sulk in a corner.
Capy's Mall. From one coin. Who would have thought.
I counted every brick. They all add up. A miracle.
Nobody needs to catch me here. It's strange and nice.
Thank you all. Without you this place would only sell air.
Something ticked loudly in Capy's pocket.
My watch... Did it just come alive?
Sure enough, the golden watch crawls out of the pocket and hangs in the air. The hands spin backwards.
Hello, Capy. I've waited long. An eternity, if you don't count coffee breaks.
I'm the Watch of Time. I can rewind minutes. Refunds not included.
Your mall is wonderful. But imagine going through it all again, with experience.
Start over? But everything's already built here...
Not lose, but build wiser. Friends stay, knowledge stays. Coins don't. That's the economy.
Wiser... Sounds not bad. I need to think.
When you decide, just wind me up. I'm here. Ticking.
